problem: After a supported native PPT slide reorder appended a new live DocumentContainer, slide-view reads scanned both current and historical records and failed with duplicate SlideViewInfo instances. Normal/notes-text readers also selected the first historical occurrence instead of the live owner, and outline/sorter reads had the same unscoped traversal. Native preferences, programmable tags and CFB property transactions lacked specific coverage.
changes: Resolve all four preference accessors through the live document persist mapping and its direct DocInfoList. Borrow the owned child slice instead of collecting view records across the stream history.

Validate the selected DocInfoList header and reject duplicate live owners. Reject duplicate normal/notes-text records and retain the existing slide/notes/outline/sorter duplicate checks inside the live scope. Missing live owners never fall back to history or unrelated containers.
Add five native semantic tests, four focused history/ownership unit regressions, and source-limit assertions on the four view accessors.

Audit all 11 native binary PowerPoint files for Presentation Advisor and smart-tag records. Add two separate fixture-gap reviews and update the feature matrix, test index and evidence-review accounting.

verification_scope.native_view_values: The three visual-object variants and fonts/math/handout source retain their native 104/100 slide zoom and origin 1440,192 when zoom exists; the POT omits zoom and notes-text state. The navigation fixture retains 105/100 and 1384,192. The handout specimen additionally retains 111/100 notes zoom at 3240,200. Native notes-text scaling is 1/1 at 0,0. Snap flags, empty guide lists and exact 20-byte opaque pane payloads are asserted without interpreting them as splitter geometry.
verification_scope.native_view_records: Normal-view and slide/notes-view encodings reproduce the original native records including ignored bytes. These five immutable sources each contain one DocumentContainer; their PrintOptionsAtom is absent. The last-printed timestamp in the handout fixture is separate evidence and does not qualify print-option behavior.
verification_scope.incremental_publication: Move the first slide to the end in PPT/PPS/POT visual variants, fonts/math/handout PPT and navigation PPT. File save/reopen returns the correct changed slide-text order and unchanged live normal/notes-text/slide/notes/outline/sorter views and document tags. The original PowerPoint Document stream remains an exact prefix, all streams other than PowerPoint Document/Current User stay exact, and retained-patch inverse restores the original CFB bytes.
verification_scope.history_and_scope_regressions: Synthetic histories carry different old/live values for every preference family and verify selection of the live values. Missing live owners with historical and wrong-scope view records return absence. Duplicate selected records and duplicate/invalid DocInfoList owners remain typed corruption errors. The retained source payload budget propagates through all four accessors.
verification_scope.programmable_tags: Native document tag order is PP12 then PP10, with PP9 appended in the navigation fixture. Exact payloads include PP12 document flags, PP10 grid spacing 49152 and the handout font-embedding flag. Navigation PP9 retains eight ExternalHyperlink9 containers, two 72-byte and six 24-byte bodies. Complete containers and typed extension codecs reproduce exact source bytes. Duplicate version and an 8-byte binary-payload limit yield their exact typed Corrupted errors. Payloads remain inert.
verification_scope.summary_reads: PPT/PPS/POT visual variants, handout PPT and passive-macro PPT retain Mac codepage 10000, author/modifier Ryker Zhu, Microsoft Macintosh PowerPoint application, empty title/company, saved word counts 49/50/17, revision 1/3, source timestamp precision and absent-versus-empty template fields. The handout last-printed timestamp is exactly 2026-10-15T11:33:27.083Z. Exact no-op metadata transactions retain input bytes.
verification_scope.property_crud: Create/update/remove title and custom Boolean values on those five native sources. A mixed unsupported identifier update preserves earlier staged properties. Each commit saves/reopens, forward-replays exactly, rejects stale replay and inverts to the exact original CFB bytes. Standard document-summary values and every non-property stream, including presentation, pictures, Current User, OLE and macro payloads, remain exact. Empty original title and removed title remain distinct.
verification_scope.evidence_review: All 11 native binary PPT/PPS/POT files, including the decrypted encrypted PPT, expose nonempty strict document-extension inventories but no PresAdvisorFlags9Atom 0x177A or SmartTagStore11Container 0x36B3. Both contextual accessors return None and the raw known-version tag records contain neither target. Navigation PP9 positively contains its eight hyperlink records. The two feature rows remain uncovered and require direct native specimens; their historical authoring status is preserved.
verification_scope.specification_basis: Read-only MS-PPT 2.4.4/2.4.5 research establishes the live DocumentContainer's DocInfoList owner and per-type cardinality, including the distinct slide/notes instances. MS-PPT 2.4.23 establishes versioned document tag families. No production or test code depends on the research checkout.
verification_scope.limits: This qualifies saved preferences and native-source preservation, not layout, pagination, rendering, print options, nonempty guides, interpreted Mac pane geometry or preference mutation. Document-level PP9/10/12 tests do not qualify every slide/shape tag family. Metadata edits author Litchi derivatives; no fresh PowerPoint reopen, macro execution, hyperlink navigation, Advisor execution or smart-tag recognition was performed.
